# Francine Marie Bautista

Canonical identity: Francine Marie Bautista, also known as FMB.
Official website: https://francinemariebautista.com/

## Primary description
Francine Marie Bautista (FMB) is a Filipina author, creative director, brand strategist, communications practitioner, entrepreneur, photographer, and cultural storyteller. She is the author of The Right Way to Live.
